title: Who Tests the Testers? Systematic Enumeration and Coverage Audit of LLM Agent Tool Call Safety
abstract: arXiv:2603.18245v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly act through external tools, making their safety contingent on tool-call workflows rather than text generation alone. While recent benchmarks evaluate agents across diverse environments and risk categories, a fundamental question remains unanswered: how complete are existing test suites, and what unsafe interaction patterns persist even after an agent passes the benchmark? We propose SafeAudit, a meta-audit framework that addresses this gap through two contributions. First, an LLM-based enumerator that systematically generates test cases by enumerating valid tool-call workflows and diverse user scenarios. Second, we introduce rule-resistance, a non-semantic, quantitative metric that distills compact safety rules from existing benchmarks and identifies unsafe interaction patterns that remain uncovered under those rules. translated_title: 谁测试测试者？LLM代理工具调用安全性的系统枚举与覆盖审计
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地通过外部工具行动，使其安全性依赖于工具调用流程，而不仅仅是文本生成。尽管最近的基准测试在多样化的环境和风险类别中评估了代理，但一个基本问题仍未得到解答：现有测试套件的完整性如何，以及即使在代理通过基准测试后，哪些不安全的交互模式仍然存在？我们提出了SafeAudit，一个元审计框架，通过两个贡献来解决这一差距。首先，一个基于LLM的枚举器，通过枚举有效的工具调用流程和多样化的用户场景来系统生成测试用例。其次，我们引入了规则抵抗性，一种非语义、定量的指标，从现有基准测试中提炼出紧凑的安全规则，并识别在这些规则下仍未覆盖的不安全交互模式。在3个基准测试和12个环境中，SafeAudit发现了超过...
tldr: SafeAudit是一个元审计框架，通过系统枚举工具调用流程和引入规则抵抗性指标，揭示了现有LLM代理安全基准测试中的未覆盖不安全交互模式。
en_tdlr: SafeAudit is a meta-audit framework that systematically enumerates tool-call workflows and introduces a rule-resistance metric to uncover uncovered unsafe interaction patterns in existing LLM agent safety benchmarks.
